say:1:1341102001:1.text: Mr. Faramor, will you be staying in Cedartown after the festival is over?
say:1:1341102001:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，祭典结束以后，你会一直留在雪松镇吗？

say:2:1341102002:1.text: I might indulge in a short stay, but nothing permanent. After all, as an undead hunter, I'm not yet ready to rest.
say:2:1341102002:1.source_cn: 或许会小住一段时间。但我不会定居在这里，作为亡灵猎人，...

say:4:1341102003:1.text: Do you belong to an organization?
say:4:1341102003:1.source_cn: 亡灵猎人也是一个组织吗？

say:5:1341102004:1.text: We have a few dozen members, most of whom come from the Lightbearer Empire. I'm one of the few Wilder members.
say:5:1341102004:1.source_cn: 我们只有几十个成员，大部分都来自耀光帝国，我是加入组织...

say:6:1341102005:1.text: Is hunting the Graveborn your goal?
say:6:1341102005:1.source_cn: 你们的目标就是狩猎亡灵？

say:7:1341102006:1.text: According to the recruiter, the organization was originally founded to root out the Bantus Graveborn trying to infiltrate the Lightbearer Empire.
say:7:1341102006:1.source_cn: 招募我的成员说，最初组织建立的目的，是为了追击那些试图...

say:8:1341102007:1.text: Bantus... You must have heard of it, right?
say:8:1341102007:1.source_cn: 班题斯……你们应该知道吧？

choice_prompt:9:1341102007.text: Bantus... You must have heard of it, right?
choice_prompt:9:1341102007.source_cn: 班题斯……你们应该知道吧？

say:10:1341102008:1.text: It's ancient and long since fallen. Now, it's occupied by the Graveborn.
say:10:1341102008:1.source_cn: 没错。很古老，但早已覆灭了，现在是名副其实的亡灵帝国。

say:11:1341102009:1.text: Most of my allies go after the Bantus Graveborn who are trying to infiltrate and destroy the Lightbearer Empire.
say:11:1341102009:1.source_cn: 嗯，我的同伴大多数都是为了追猎班题斯的亡灵——那些试图...

say:12:1341102010:1.text: As for me, I target those who have corrupted my homeland. They violated our sacred places, causing the deaths of many...
say:12:1341102010:1.source_cn: 但我的主要目标是找到那些污染了我家乡的亡灵们。他们用邪...

say:14:1341102011:1.text: Graveborn, corruption, invasion... Reminds me of what happened in the Dark Forest! Could this be part of the Adamant Syndicate's scheme?!
say:14:1341102011:1.source_cn: 亡灵、污染、侵袭……听起来很像薄暮丛林发生的事情！难道...

say:15:1341102012:1.text: Did something similar happen in the Dark Forest before? And the Adamant Syndicate... What's that?
say:15:1341102012:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林也发生过类似的事情？至于黑金商会又是……？

say:16:1341102013:1.text: Your input means a lot to me! I'll kick off my investigation once the festival ends. If you know anything else, feel free to share it with me.
say:16:1341102013:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的情报，这对我来说很重要。等到祭典结束，我会从...

say:17:1341102014:1.text: Sure thing! You're always welcome to visit us, Mr. Faramor!
say:17:1341102014:1.source_cn: 没问题！法拉莫尔先生，我们随时恭候你的到来！
